// P-FLOW-01 RED fixture: a tenant-less query over the workflow journal — the cross-tenant IDOR (F2)
// bug class the tenant-predicate lint (ID-3) rejects. Every flow table's tenant-first PK enforces
// the no-cross-tenant-query-path floor; a query with no tenant binder breaks it.
fn dispatch() {
    let runs = sqlx::query("SELECT * FROM workflow_run WHERE state = 'running'").fetch_all(&pool).await?;
}
